WEO2025.basis: Q1 verified generation pathways, 2024 baseline 31,229 TWh. Rounded planning cases 60,000 and 80,000 TWh; not final electricity consumption.

GWEC2026.basis: Industry report: 92.5 GW offshore at end-2025, 9.3 GW commissioned in 2025, forecast 420 GW by 2035.

GOWA2050.basis: IRENA discussion of Global Offshore Wind Alliance 2,000 GW target. A target and feasibility assessment, not current forecast.

IRENA2465.basis: IRENA 1.5-degree scenario: 2,465 GW offshore wind in 2050. Relevant external scale comparison, not endorsement of our allocation.

OffshoreResource.basis: Technical resource above 420,000 TWh/year and illustrative new-project capacity factors 40–50%; technical potential is not commercially available electricity.

IRENACost2025.basis: Previously verified in Q2. 2025 USD global averages offshore wind $78/MWh and installed cost $2,931/kW; tidal/wave estimates use an earlier-stage evidence base.

ORE2022.basis: Model: £78 ±25/MWh in 2012 pounds by 2035 assuming 2.6 GW global deployment, including 877 MW UK and 783 MW France. 1 GW UK/France instead corresponds to £98 ±32/MWh.

TidalPracticalResource.basis: Coles et al., peer-reviewed practical UK/Channel Islands tidal-stream estimate: 11.5 GW and 34 TWh/year. Regional, not global.

TidalSystem2026.basis: Coles and Adcock GB dispatch model: replacing up to 5 GW offshore wind with tidal reduced gas generation 20% and dispatch costs/emissions 6.5% in the selected case. Does not include full comparative capital costs.

OEE2026.basis: European tidal cumulative generation 127 GWh through 2025; not annual global output. Report is titled Ocean Energy Market Outlook 2025.

DOEFloatTarget.basis: Published historical goal $45/MWh by 2035, not $74. A research target, not a bid or verified current cost.

Hywind.basis: Operator reports 54% mean output over first five years of 30 MW pilot. Not a global fleet performance assumption.

HywindMaintenance.basis: Heavy maintenance on all five turbines is a reminder that historical mean output does not remove repair and access risks.

Geothermal.basis: Conditional lower-cost development case of up to 800 GW and almost 6,000 TWh by 2050; not the agency's baseline forecast.

MarineEnvironment.basis: OES-Environmental synthesis: larger-array effects and turbine collision risks need further monitoring. Small demonstrations do not settle cumulative impacts.

WaveResource2012.basis: Gunn and Stock-Williams: 2.11 TW gross resource, 4.6% captured by the chosen converter configuration. Not a universal limit for every device.

OTECResource2013.basis: Rajagopalan and Nihous model. Abstract retrieved through author-hosted research record; 7 and 14 TW correspond to different extraction/environmental cases, not an economic supply forecast.

NASA2024.basis: Previously reviewed Q2 conceptual space-to-Earth solar models. No commercial Earth power service established.

SuppliedData.basis: User-supplied raw time series, processing script, profiles and LP results; provenance and corrections recorded in MODEL_AUDIT.md. Reproduction is not independent validation of ocean-model accuracy.
